name: skyx-infrastructure
description: Safe, incremental AWS CDK adoption model for SkyX production infrastructure.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run synth && npm run verify:manifest
scripts.verify:ecr: cdk synth SkyxEcrAdoption -c adoptionComponent=ecr -c ecrRepository=skyx-backend >/dev/null && node scripts/verify-ecr-adoption.mjs
scripts.verify:observability: cdk synth SkyxObservability -c hardeningComponent=observability -c alarmTopicArn=arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:129346407469:skyx-alerts -c elb5xxThreshold=5 -c rdsConnectionsThreshold=80 >/dev/null && node scripts/verify-observability.mjs
scripts.verify:ecs-scaling: cdk synth SkyxEcsScaling -c hardeningComponent=ecs-scaling -c apiMinCapacity=1 -c apiMaxCapacity=4 -c apiTargetCpu=60 -c frontendMinCapacity=1 -c frontendMaxCapacity=3 -c frontendTargetCpu=60 >/dev/null && node scripts/verify-ecs-scaling.mjs
scripts.verify:waf: cdk synth SkyxWaf -c hardeningComponent=waf -c wafMode=count >/dev/null && node scripts/verify-waf.mjs
scripts.verify:log-retention: cdk synth SkyxLogRetention -c hardeningComponent=log-retention -c retentionDays=30 >/dev/null && node scripts/verify-log-retention.mjs
